note: Game balance values for soldiers (not real-world data). Damage per hit = caliber base x zone multiplier; 100 HP per life. Loadout pools include sandbox / later-war weapons (StG 44, M3, FG 42): they are not a claim about 6 June 1944 issue.

kits.note: SW1: AI types Blaster troopers (trooper) and Robot commandos (robot): the soldier brain in the kit's body (content/characters/<model>.glb, local-only bakes; missing: the soldier body), carrying only the kit's weighted blasters (no sidearm, no grenades), on either side. robot: hp share, pace and aim-turn factors, hits spark instead of bleeding.
kits.desert_note: DSD1: AI type Desert soldiers on the Delta Force path (gunbody.cpp deltaBodyPose clipHold): the desert soldier's own body (desert_m4.glb's, its built-in gun dropped) with Delta Force's Mixamo clips retargeted (tools/bake_gunbody.py --retarget --rig figrig; content/characters/desert_body.glb, local-only: the clips' licence is not stated; missing: the soldier body), the guns of its old bodies drawn in its hands (the Vector stand-in UMP-45 kept), the 9 mm pistol carried, one in four also the RPG-7, frags; the fireball flash stays Delta Force's
kits.allied_note: WS1 (merged WSM1): kits.allied is AI type 25 Allied paratroopers (kit 7); kits.ss (kit 8) has no AI type yet (AI types 21 Allied soldiers and 23 SS soldiers keep their NA1 built-in-gun bodies, gunbody_models). On the Delta Force path (gunbody.cpp deltaBodyPose): each on its own body (allied_garand.glb's / ss_kar98k.glb's, the built-in gun dropped) with its own Mixamo rifle / pistol / death packs, the grenade throws and the prone / slide / vault / hit / turn clips (83 clips; tools/bake_gunbody.py --retarget --rig figrig; content/characters/allied_body.glb, ss_body.glb, local-only: the clips' licence is not stated; missing: the soldier body). Every WWII gun of its side drawn in its hands.
kits.kr714_note: RB1: AI type Mechs (slot 24) with perf mechrobot on: the KR-714 robot (content/characters/skin_robot.glb, an original procedural model made in-house by tools/robot_build.py) on allied_body's skeleton, the soldier brain, clips and the Allied kit's guns; mechrobot off: the melee mech (zombie.json 'mech'). RB6 (user: 1.5x size, 4x health, only the M249, eyes glowing red): 'scale' 1.5 (this kit only: draw, held gun and muzzle with the hands, hit zones, eye / chest heights, stride rate; the movement capsule stays the soldier's), 'hp' 4.0 (400), 'ai' the M249 alone with no sidearm or launcher ('ai_fallback' the BAR when the M249's model is missing), 'lmg_standing': fires it standing and on the move as an automatic rifle (no belt-gun crouch or standing spread penalty)
kits.delta_note: FSB1: AI type FSB operator (was Delta Force; slot 20, kit 4) wears skin_fsb (the FSB Operator model by Mateusz Wolinski, CC-BY-4.0: docs/credits.md) on allied_body's skeleton. DF1: AI type Delta Force: the user's Mixamo rifle / pistol / grenade packs in one body (content/characters/delta_force.glb, local-only: missing, the soldier body), the game's guns in procedural hands (gunbody.cpp deltaBodyPose); the primary weighted per slot + life, the sidearm in turn per slot, frags per life

loadouts_operator.note: AI5: Operator bots (AiType::Operators) draw from these modern weapons instead of the faction pool and the class weapons: weighted primary, every lmgEvery-th operator on a side carries the LMG, all carry the sidearm; TK1: one in launcherEvery also carries the launcher, used on armour and heavy enemy types. Grenades stay the side's (no modern grenade is modelled). Battle Royale keeps its bare-hands start (royale loot rules).

hold_bodies_note: WSM2: every human soldier body is a skin on the Allied paratrooper's skeleton (tools/bake_gunbody.py --skin: the soldier's own mesh and weights posed onto the Allied joints and proportions), playing the clips of the model named here (allied_body: 83 Mixamo clips, borrowed by joint name at load) with the game's guns in the stored per-gun holds (content/weapons/*.json hold.pose). A missing skin or clip source: the soldier body and the procedural pose.
operator_models_note: AI type Operators: soldiers (the same brain, weapons and procedural pose) wearing these bodies, one per AI in turn; a missing file leaves the faction's soldier body (tools/bake_ai_characters.py operators, docs/credits.md)
gunbody_models_note: WSM2: empty, the bodies with the gun built in (NA1 / GM1 / GM2 bakes, gunbody.cpp bi mode) are no longer used; every human type wears a hold body (hold_bodies). The old files are left in content/characters until the user has seen the result
operator_f_note: OPF1: AI type Giant Operator (44): an Operator in everything (brain, loadouts_operator guns, the Allied skeleton's clips and holds, health) but its body and size. models: a preference order, the first whose file exists (skin_operator_f1 is local-only, git-ignored; absent: the operator body at the same size). scale: what a kit's scale drives (drawn body, held gun, hit zones, eye / chest heights, stride); the movement capsule stays the soldier's
